analysis.reasonEn: The previous read (10/20) was buy, followed by a wait-and-see on 10/21, then a switch to buy on 10/22. This buy signal is maintained for the third consecutive session. RSI at 36.9 confirms an exit from oversold territory. CCI at -275.9 shows an extreme oversold condition followed by a rebound signal. Volume ratio at 2.02x the 5-day average indicates strong momentum. The price is up 25.8% from the 52-week low. Despite a 12.1% drop from the 5-day high of $738.49, a Higher Low pattern is forming, up 1.5% from the 20-day low of $639.69. The price is trading 2.72% above the SMA200 ($631.68) and 0.89% above the EMA200 ($643.15). Weekly RSI is at 50.8, indicating a neutral zone. ADX at 28.1 suggests a clear trend is forming. While -DI (31.0) is higher than +DI (21.0), the extreme CCI rebound offsets this. The 4-hour RSI is at 27.1, entering oversold territory. Quantitative buy attractiveness is 72/100, which is positive. Position is at 1x target weight; next card is leverage.
